Hi Priya,

Yes — we can share our SOC 2 Type II report under NDA.

Process (standard):
1) Execute mutual NDA (or share yours for review).
2) Once executed, we provide a restricted, view-only link to the SOC 2 report and supporting artifacts.

Attached: Redwood Inference - Mutual NDA (HelioFin) - v3 (pdf).

Two quick notes we include in all evidence shares:
- SOC 2 materials are confidential; please limit distribution to those who need it for your assessment.
- The report includes scope details (systems/services) and the audit period; we can also provide a short “bridge letter” to cover the period from the report end date to present.

If you prefer to send your NDA, that works as well. Daniel (cc’d) helps me track evidence distribution and can coordinate the secure folder access once we have an executed NDA.

Best,
Olga Petrov
GRC / Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
